# OneIssuer

> OneIssuer is a lightweight, self-hosted OpenID Connect provider for developers and small teams.

## UI Prototype

- [Hosted sign-in](/login), [registration](/register), and [consent](/consent)
- [Administration console](/admin)
- This preview uses mock data and does not perform real authentication or issue tokens.

## Documentation

- Backend design: `/docs/go-backend-design.md`
- UI design: `/docs/ui-design.md`
